sloka: विश्वामित्रो गते राजा वैदेहम् मिथिला अधिपम् ।आपृष्ट्व इव जगाम आशु राजा दशरथः पुरीम् ॥१-७४-२॥
transliteration: viśvāmitro gate rājā vaideham mithilā adhipam ।āpṛṣṭva iva jagāma āśu rājā daśarathaḥ purīm ॥1-74-2॥

translations.english: With the departure of Viswamitra, king Dasaratha who was the source of happiness to his subjects took leave of Janaka, king of Mithila and speedily set out for the city of Ayodhya.
